about.title: About KNIGHT ROOFING GENERAL CONTRACTORS
text: We started Knight Roofing because homeowners in our area deserved better. Too many people in Pearland and the surrounding Gulf Coast communities were dealing with roofers who didn’t show up on time, didn’t communicate, or left behind work that failed the first real storm.

We grew up here. We know Pearland, Manvel, Friendswood, and the neighborhoods around Shadow Creek Ranch, Silverlake, and West Oaks Village. We’ve seen firsthand how Texas heat, heavy rain, and sudden windstorms wear down roofs — and how frustrating insurance claims and TWIA requirements can be for homeowners.

As our company grew, customers began asking for help with interior projects, bathroom remodels, and ADA‑focused accessibility upgrades. They wanted the same honesty, communication, and workmanship we brought to roofing — but inside their homes. So we expanded our services to include bathroom remodeling, walk‑in showers, tub‑to‑shower conversions, ADA modifications, and general contracting work.
